summary.text: Carol Ode is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-18 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Carol Ode earned a B.A. in history from the University of Vermont in 1978 and a J.D. from Cornell Law School in 1982.

Ode's career experience includes working as a legislative coordinator in the government and public affairs group of Downs Rachlin Martin and as a consultant for the Vermont Bar Foundation and the Access to Justice Coalition.
Governor Howard Dean appointed Ode to the Vermont State Board of Education, where she served as chair, and Ode also served on the Burlington School Board.
In the 2023-2024 session, Ode served on the Ways and Means Committee and the Legislative Committee on Administrative Rules.
